assertions.interpretation: The scene is set at the moment when Wang Dun's army was about to reach the Daheng bridge.
Emperor Ming personally came out to Zhongtang, concurrent with the army's approach.
Wen Qiao held the office of Danyang Yin at this time, providing his official capacity during the scene.
The emperor ordered the bridge to be cut but it had not yet been cut, a state of affairs at the scene moment.
The emperor became greatly angry and glared, a reaction occurring at the scene moment.
The emperor summoned the various lords, an event within the scene.
When Wen Qiao arrived he did not apologize but only asked for wine and roasted meat, a sequential event in the scene.
Wen Qiao then apologized and the emperor was relieved, the resolution of the scene.
The various lords together praised Wang Dao's quick wit and famous words, an outcome following the scene's resolution.
